answers.core: Signals are an important part of Godot's architecture and with Godot 4, multithreading is becoming an important part as well. This could save a lot of boilerplate when needing to jump back to the main thread.
answers.workaround: Yes. You can create a function for each signal and use `call_deferred` on that function.

title: Create an emit_deferred on signals for easy access to main thread
